review.exclusions: The Stanford direct location timed out. The CHM archive of the authored VAX report was examined as a separate implementation control. The Medley and VM publications remain controls with their own editions. No historical executables were run.
review.independence_limit: Fresh review independently reacquired and checked the exact texts. The two executions and multiple acquisition URLs for one catalog do not supply independent original evidence.
